entities.convention: Contours are quadratic, and consecutive off-curve points expand to an on-curve midpoint.
entities.note: TrueType glyf curves are quadratic, and two consecutive off-curve points imply an on-curve midpoint (OpenType Specification, glyf).

entities.convention: CFF curves are cubic Béziers on the em square.
entities.note: CFF CharStrings are cubic Béziers rather than TrueType quadratics (Adobe Technical Note 5177, Type 2 Charstring Format).

entities.convention: CFF2 CharStrings are cubic Béziers on the same em square.
entities.note: CFF2 CharStrings are cubic Béziers on the same em square as CFF (Adobe Technical Note 5177, Type 2 Charstring Format).

headers.name: unitsPerEm
headers.note: unitsPerEm is the em square for TrueType and for CFF (OpenType Specification, head).
